summary: Comprehensive backend (pytest, 55 tests) + frontend smoke (admin/coach/parent logins + dashboards) for Badminton Academy Manager. Initial run found 13 failures dominated by FastAPI ObjectId serialization (insert_one mutates dict with _id, then `**doc` leaked it into JSON responses). I fixed 6 routes by popping _id before returning. After fixes: 55/55 backend pass, all 3 role dashboards render KPIs and upcoming classes correctly with httpOnly cookies + cross-origin CORS.

minor.issue: Doc says samesite=lax but code uses samesite=none; secure=true. Functional but inconsistent.
Response does not include coach_id field per item (only coach_name); test had to use response objects without coach_id check.

issues: Recharts emits console warning 'width(-1) and height(-1)' on initial render (cosmetic only, chart still renders correctly after layout settles).

action_items: Verify the 6 ObjectId fixes look acceptable to E1 (create_payment, create_expense, upsert_payout_rule, create_enrollment, create_lesson_plan, create_progress_note, send_message all now pop _id before spreading doc).
Optional: align /app/auth_testing.md doc with actual cookie settings (samesite=none, secure=true).
Optional: add coach_id to GET /api/sessions list response items for cleaner role-scoping verification on frontend.
critical_code_review_comments: ObjectId leakage pattern was repeated across 7 POST handlers (now fixed by popping _id). Recommend adding a tiny helper `_strip_id(doc)` to avoid recurrence.
JWT secret stored in plain .env — fine for dev; rotate in prod.
Brute force lockout state uses ip:email composite which is good. clear_attempts run after successful login — verified working.
Audit log writes after every mutating action — verified via /api/audit-logs.
coach_payouts.calculate skips when existing status == 'paid' (correct), but admin has no UI/route to force-recalc. Acceptable for Phase 1.
test_credentials: admin@badminton.app / Admin@12345, coach@badminton.app / Coach@12345, parent@badminton.app / Parent@12345 (auto-seeded on startup)
seed_data_creation: Tests created prefixed TEST_ sessions/students/enrollments/payments/expenses/payouts/lesson plans/progress notes/messages. The end-of-suite soft-deletes the test session; other artifacts persist (idempotent on rerun).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend is now stable; ObjectId-in-response bug fixed across 7 routes. Tests use REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL (https://shuttle-flow.preview.emergentagent.com). All 3 role dashboards visually verified. Future runs should clean coach_payouts collection for the seeded coach if asserting exact 27.0 amount, otherwise prior 'paid' payouts will short-circuit recalculation (test already self-cleans via direct mongo delete).
rca of the issue: Root cause: pymongo `await db.<coll>.insert_one(doc)` mutates the input dict by inserting an `_id: ObjectId(...)` field. Several POST handlers returned `{'id': str(r.inserted_id), **doc}` directly — the spread re-injected the raw ObjectId which FastAPI/jsonable_encoder cannot serialize → 500 'ObjectId object is not iterable'. Reproduction: any POST to /api/payments, /api/expenses, /api/payout-rules, /api/enrollments, /api/lesson-plans, /api/progress-notes, /api/messages would 500. Mitigation: call `doc.pop('_id', None)` before returning. Permanent fix recommendation: introduce a shared `_serialize(doc, oid)` helper.
